recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man in a pinstriped shirt against a deep black background, featuring a high-contrast interplay between a minimalist sans-serif header and a decorative, swash-heavy script title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject dominates the right two-thirds of the frame
Decorative script balances the subject's torso on the left
Pinstripe patterns provide geometric texture against the flat black void
Warm skin tones contrast with cool blue typographic accents
coreInvariants: Extensive decorative swashes on the secondary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly off-center to the right, cropped from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the lines of the pinstripe shirt, and then sweep left to the decorative script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space in the upper left and far right edges creates a moody, intimate atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and one cool accent

letterConstructionRules: Title: High-contrast script with extreme flourishing and interlocking swashes
Swashes must form a cloud-like circular frame around the words
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders extended into circular loops
Initial capitals integrated into the surrounding swash pattern
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a sterile, modern sans-serif and a hyper-decorative, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the top header.
Provides the necessary high-contrast strokes and swash potential for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a middle-aged man with brown hair, wearing a white pinstriped shirt with an open collar, set against a solid black background. Lighting is soft and directional from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a light-weight, wide-tracked sans-serif name at the top center in white. Place a large, sky-blue decorative script title on the left side, featuring elaborate circular swashes that overlap the subject's sleeve.

verificationChecks: Does the script title have extensive decorative loops?
Is the top text centered and widely spaced?
Is the shirt pattern clearly pinstriped?

adjustableVariables: Amount of negative space on the left
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Any record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth transitions between skin and shadows
Ensure swashes do not obscure the subject's face
Verify the pinstripes are sharp and not blurred
Confirm the blue color is distinct against the black and white
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Black Background + Pinstripes + (Geometric Sans Header / Ornate Script Title)
